title: Reinforcement Learning Inspired Black-box Adversarial Attacks for Computer Vision
abstract: arXiv:2609.24249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks, both convolution or transformer based, are essential for modern computer vision systems. However, they are vulnerable to small perturbations, almost imperceptible to humans, which significantly alter the model's prediction. These adversarial attacks are often considered to be a significant threat to the implementation of neural networks in safety-critical applications. Most attacks utilize the white-box threat model and therefore require full access to the target model, making them unrealistic to use in practice. We propose a novel approach under the more realistic black-box threat model that utilizes concepts from reinforcement learning to optimize perturbations with a non-differentiable target model. Reinforcement learning algorithms have already been optimized to be query efficient, making them an ideal starting point when designing black-box adversarial attacks. translated_title: 受强化学习启发的计算机视觉黑盒对抗攻击方法
translated_abstract: 无论是基于卷积还是基于Transformer的神经网络，都是现代计算机视觉系统的核心。然而，它们容易受到微小扰动的攻击——这些扰动对人类来说几乎难以察觉，却能显著改变模型的预测结果。这类对抗攻击通常被视为神经网络在安全关键应用中部署的重大威胁。大多数攻击采用白盒威胁模型，因此需要对目标模型的完全访问权限，这使得它们在实际中难以应用。我们在更现实的黑盒威胁模型下提出了一种新方法，该方法利用强化学习的概念来针对不可微的目标模型优化扰动。强化学习算法已被优化得具有很高的查询效率，这使其成为设计黑盒对抗攻击的理想起点。我们展示了这种强化学习启发方法在攻击中的成功表现。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受强化学习启发的黑盒对抗攻击方法，利用强化学习算法的高查询效率来针对不可微的目标模型优化扰动，弥补了白盒攻击在实际应用中的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning inspired black-box adversarial attack method that leverages the query efficiency of RL algorithms to optimize perturbations against non-differentiable target models, addressing the practical limitations of white-box attacks.
